cures.title: Correct the inverted premultiply rationale (drawer/styles.css:183-185)
cures.detail: The restored rationale states the mechanism backwards: premultiplied interpolation is what makes a 0-alpha endpoint chroma-inert; the black/desaturation drag is the NON-premultiplied handling of rgb(0 0 0 / 0). One-clause reword — either state it correctly or revert to the house form that names the hole without minting a mechanism (dock.css:106-107 does this right). D4 sustained verbatim on disk.

cures.title: Strike the false rendering claim in the HandMark exclusion (tests/styles/stacked-url-filter.test.ts:126-127)
cures.detail: "never a composited CSS filter" is false — an SVG filter presentation attribute IS the CSS filter property at author-origin-zero and composites; HandMark.vue:299 genuinely paints one. Keep the true ground (postcss never sees presentation attributes; the detector reads authored CSS only) and delete the false safety clause — C1's whole point was honest grounds. Optionally add one clause admitting the stacked predicate is file-local co-occurrence (url() paint + own-markup backdrop class), not DOM ancestry, so #40 must flip the latch manually if it cures by relocation (D6 caveat).

Add one clause echoing the sibling seat's honest posture: resolved nesting KNOWN-LIVE, NOT GATED, pending row-6's Safari π. In color-mix-endpoints.test.ts:13-18, add dock.css (24) to the named-contributor list — it names every inherited file and the cause but not the round's own top contributor. Prose only; the expression itself is confirmed[0]'s cure verbatim and stands (D1 deflated from S1 to disclosure; D2/D3 refuted as defects of this lane).

cures.title: Fold pointer-events-none into the cn() merge (DrawerOverlay.vue:74)
cures.detail: `:class="[scrimClass, 'pointer-events-none']"` puts the utility outside tailwind-merge while props.class merges inside scrimClass — a consumer's pointer-events-auto yields an order-dependent both-present conflict where the replaced inline style was unconditionally authoritative. Use cn with the utility last in the non-modal branch (e.g. `cn(scrimClass.value, 'pointer-events-none')`) so merge semantics keep it authoritative. D7 sustained; the re-pointed detents assertions pass through the conflict so they don't cover it.

cures.title: Narrow the Escape guard (GlassDock.vue:218)
cures.detail: Fidelity is clean — `closest('[data-state="open"]')` is confirmed[8]'s first ordered option verbatim — but the predicate is broader than "open dismissable layer": reka stamps data-state=open on Accordion/Collapsible/Tooltip too, so an open accordion in the pane silently eats Escape (D8), and unbounded closest() walks past the dock root so a dock hosted inside any open layer can never Escape-collapse (F7). Bound the match inside fullEl and narrow the predicate to dismissable layers, or take the order's own alternative (open-layer count from dockContext). The new :439 arm stays valid either way.
